builds.name: Reference: Mana burst
builds.goal: Reference for Vex: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: An anti-mobility burst mage who holds periodic fear to interrupt engages, consumes dash-generated marks and follows kills through R resets. Hold/consume fear deliberately and record dash-generated marks. R resets require actual takedowns; repeated burn cannot substitute for reaching and surviving the entry. AP and penetration support a short spell sequence; Luden supplies mana/proc pressure.
testPlan: Kit question for Vex: Hold/consume fear deliberately and record dash-generated marks. R resets require actual takedowns; repeated burn cannot substitute for reaching and surviving the entry.

Start with the early core (Luden, then Shadowflame) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP and penetration support a short spell sequence; Luden supplies mana/proc pressure. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Mana is wasted on resource-free champions; target health and proc readiness change burst.

The route fails Vex's stated kit question: Hold/consume fear deliberately and record dash-generated marks. R resets require actual takedowns; repeated burn cannot substitute for reaching and surviving the entry.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Mana is wasted on resource-free champions; target health and proc readiness change burst.
Full cost 16,800 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Luden, then Shadowflame. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Zhonya's Hourglass are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

kitEvidence.formula:
Shadow excitedly surges forward, dealing @spell.VexR:RDamageCalc@ magic damage and marking the first enemy champion hit for 4 seconds.

Recast: Dash to the marked champion, dealing @spell.VexR:RecastDamageCalc@ magic damage on arrival.

If the marked champion dies within @spell.VexR:TakedownWindow@ seconds of taking damage from this Ability, its Cooldown is temporarily reset.

Every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=25, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds Vex becomes afflicted with Doom, causing her next basic Ability to Knock Down and Fear enemies for [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.75, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.25, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.25, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.25, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds.

Whenever a nearby enemy dashes or blinks, Vex marks them with Gloom for [6] seconds. Vex's next Attack against a Gloomed enemy deals an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 150; raw flags preserved) + (0.25) × AP] magic damage and reduces this Ability's Cooldown by [25]%.

Vex gains [50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (0.75) × AP] Shield for [2.5] seconds and emits a shockwave that deals [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (0.3) × AP] magic damage.

Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.

Vex commands Shadow to fly to a location, increasing in size as it travels. Upon arriving, it deals [50 / 70 / 90 / 110 / 130 + (0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6) × AP] magic damage and Slows by [(0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5) × 100]% for [2] seconds.

Killing an enemy with this ability reduces Doom'n Gloom's Cooldown by [10]%.

Applies Gloom to enemies hit.

Vex launches a wave of mist that deals [70 / 115 / 160 / 205 / 250 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage. After a delay, the wave becomes smaller and faster.

Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.
